audit.method: Claude extraction drafts plus agent-assisted source, date and exemption audit; not a professional legal review

examples.purpose: Read screening and deposit duties, inspect source quotes and identify facts needed for rent protections.
Compare Jersey City and state rules, then inspect future NJ FAIR and possible local interactions in change tracking.
Review Cambridge and Massachusetts rental duties, screening costs and pending proposals with a dated property summary.

limitations: Data availability measures recorded requirements; it does not certify complete legal coverage.
Missing ownership, tenant history, occupancy certificates and exemption notices must be supplied with evidence rather than inferred from public maps.
Unmatched or ambiguous municipalities retain statewide records and candidate-city rules marked unknown.

change_evaluations.title: California AB 325 / SB 763 takes effect
change_evaluations.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective before, applies after, for every CA address.
change_evaluations.notes: Affected IDs come from imported rules and evaluated property facts, not from the fixture expectation.

change_evaluations.title: Hoboken vs Jersey City local algorithmic bans
change_evaluations.expected_behavior: HOB-ALG-01 only for Hoboken addresses; JC-ALG-01 only for Jersey City addresses; neither for Newark.
change_evaluations.notes: Affected IDs come from imported rules and evaluated property facts, not from the fixture expectation.

change_evaluations.title: NJ FAIR Act: enacted, not yet effective; possible preemption
change_evaluations.expected_behavior: not_yet_effective on 2026-10-01, applies on 2027-07-02 for every NJ address; Jersey City and Hoboken addresses carry a conflict flag for human review.
change_evaluations.notes: Affected IDs come from imported rules and evaluated property facts, not from the fixture expectation.

change_evaluations.title: Massachusetts pending bills S.2983 and H.5222
change_evaluations.expected_behavior: Reported as pending (not in force) for every Boston and Cambridge address; affected set = all MA addresses if enacted.
change_evaluations.notes: Affected IDs are hypothetical exposure if the imported pending proposals were enacted; they are not current-law protections.

change_evaluations.title: Massachusetts rent-control ballot question struck
change_evaluations.expected_behavior: No rent cap reported for any Boston or Cambridge address; IP 25-21 recorded as failed. Affected set is empty.
change_evaluations.notes: The imported proposal is recorded as failed. It produces no applicable rent cap and the affected set is empty.

note: These files use compiled sources and reviewed Census/official parcel municipality evidence, without live database overrides or user-supplied scenario facts. Fixture expectations are not source evidence. Readiness and recorded-rule availability are distinct from complete legal coverage.
